name: Hanging Leg Raise
summary: A hanging exercise that trains the abs and hip flexors while building grip strength. Bend the knees to make it easier.
setup: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, shoulders pulled slightly down.
Keep the legs together and the body still.
Brace the abs before you move.
execution: Raise your knees or straight legs by curling the pelvis up toward the ribs.
Lift until the legs are at least parallel to the floor, or higher if you control it.
Pause, then lower the legs slowly without swinging.
mistakes: Swinging the body: slow down and pause between reps.
Using only the hip flexors: tilt the pelvis up at the top.
Letting the shoulders shrug to the ears: keep the shoulders down and active.
Dropping the legs: lower slowly for 2-3 seconds.
